summary: /deconstruyendo, checked against www.serverstartup.io after the launch: two claims narrowed to what production does (only resized photographs go through Images; only responses without their own cache policy are no-store), and four facts that now hold on production shown (HTTPS redirect + HSTS, passkey-only admin, OAuth server, CLI device flow).

changes.before: Una página renderizada solo se guarda en el borde si lo pide. Cualquier otra respuesta renderizada sale con `no-store`.
changes.after: Una página renderizada solo se guarda en el borde si lo pide. Las respuestas que no declaran su propia caché salen con `no-store`.

changes.before: A rendered page is cached at the edge only if it opts in. Every other rendered response is sent `no-store`.
changes.after: A rendered page is cached at the edge only if it opts in. A response that declares no caching of its own is sent `no-store`.

changes.before: El Worker pasa cada imagen al *binding* de [`Images`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/images/optimization/binding/), que la ajusta a su hueco y la convierte a WebP.
changes.after: Las fotografías que la página redimensiona pasan por el *binding* de [`Images`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/images/optimization/binding/), que las ajusta a su hueco y las convierte a WebP. El resto se sirve tal como está en el repositorio.

changes.before: The Worker hands each image to the [`Images`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/images/optimization/binding/) binding, which resizes it to its slot and converts it to WebP.
changes.after: The photographs the page resizes go through the [`Images`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/images/optimization/binding/) binding, which fits them to their slot and converts them to WebP. Everything else is served as it is in the repository.

changes.before: Los textos y su historial viven en `D1`, la base de datos `SQLite` de `Cloudflare`. Las sesiones de quien edita se guardan en `Workers KV`, un almacén de pares clave y valor; `Images` recorta cada imagen a su hueco y la convierte a WebP, y `R2`, el almacenamiento de ficheros, queda listo para lo que se suba desde el CMS. La versión de pruebas y la de producción no comparten ninguno de los cuatro.
changes.after: Los textos y su historial viven en `D1`, la base de datos `SQLite` de `Cloudflare`. Las sesiones de quien edita se guardan en `Workers KV`, un almacén de pares clave y valor; `Images` ajusta a su hueco las fotografías que se redimensionan y las convierte a WebP, y `R2`, el almacenamiento de ficheros, queda listo para lo que se suba desde el CMS. La versión de pruebas y la de producción no comparten ninguno de los cuatro.

changes.before: The texts and their history live in `D1`, `Cloudflare`'s `SQLite` database. Editors' sessions are kept in `Workers KV`, a key-value store; `Images` crops each picture to its slot and turns it into WebP; and `R2`, the file storage, is ready for whatever is uploaded through the CMS. The preview and production share none of the four.
changes.after: The texts and their history live in `D1`, `Cloudflare`'s `SQLite` database. Editors' sessions are kept in `Workers KV`, a key-value store; `Images` fits the photographs that are resized to their slot and turns them into WebP; and `R2`, the file storage, is ready for whatever is uploaded through the CMS. The preview and production share none of the four.
